olivia (solutions): Hey team, Finsys just sent a ~50-question security questionnaire. Two asks we need quick clarity on: 1) proof of HSM-backed key rotation + rotation logs, 2) SIEM-compatible audit exports with tamper-evident delivery. Can we answer both for our Private on-prem package?

emily (sec-eng): Short answer: yes, but details matter. We need to explain KMS envelope flow, where rotation events are recorded, and how we deliver logs (signed/hashed bundle + syslog/HTTPS push).

raj (infosec): FWIW customer cares about separation of duties: who can trigger rotation, who can view key material, and if rotation ops are auditable. We should cite role names and the audit fields.

chris (sre): For Private on-prem with HSM, rotation is triggered via the control plane but executed in-customer HSM. Rotation metadata lives in our audit log and the HSM audit (if they enable it). We can export both.

olivia (solutions): They asked for an example of the rotation event JSON plus how to prove it wasn't altered after the fact. Can we provide a sample log and a delivery hash/signature?

emily (sec-eng): Yes. We'll provide a minimal example snippet and an explanation of the signing workflow. Example rotation event (redacted):

```json
{
  "event_type": "key_rotation",
  "kms_key_id": "redwood-hsm:tenant-123:enc-1",
  "rotation_initiator": "service:keystore-rotation-runner",
  "rotation_time": "2026-02-12T22:14:03Z",
  "prev_key_fingerprint": "sha256:ab12...",
  "new_key_fingerprint": "sha256:cd34...",
  "audit_id": "aa7f9b2e-...",
  "hsm_audit_reference": "slot-42-log-98765"
}
```

emily (sec-eng): For tamper-evidence we sign the exported bundle with our control-plane signing key and provide a detached signature and SHA256 checksum. Customer can verify signature against cert we include. We also optionally provide an HMAC that they can verify with their integration key.

raj (infosec): Add note about immutable append-only storage: we write rotation events into our write-once append store (immutable prefix) and replicate to the customer's SIEM. The store keeps hashes chaining each file (simple Merkle chain explanation). That helps show non-repudiation.

chris (sre): For SIEM delivery options: syslog/CEF over TLS, Amazon S3 bucket push (signed), or SFTP. Each delivery includes: compressed JSONL export + .sha256 + .sig (PKCS7). We can also provide a replay endpoint with time-bounded signed manifests.

olivia (solutions): Customer wants to know how we handle PII in logs. They asked if we can redact or provide pseudonymized artifacts.

emily (sec-eng): We can redact tenant-sensitive fields before exporting. Our export pipeline supports configurable redact rules (regex + field allowlist). We'll include a sample redaction policy snippet.

raj (infosec): Also call out retention policy and retention evidence: retention windows configurable per customer, and we can produce retention proof (signed manifest of deletion jobs).

deploy-bot: Deployment 2026-02-12T22:10:00Z started by emily. Status: success.

chris (sre): Action items for the response doc: 1) provide rotation event sample + explanation of signing and HSM reference, 2) describe delivery options with example curl commands, 3) include redaction policy example, 4) retention and replay/fetch proof. I can draft the delivery commands.

olivia (solutions): Thanks. Can someone produce the example cURL + manifest format we can paste into the SQ response? Need it by EOD.

emily (sec-eng): I'll write the rotation JSON and the signing blurb.

chris (sre): Draft cURL for S3 push + verify:
```bash
# fetch signed bundle
curl -o bundle.jsonl.gz "https://s3.amazonaws.com/finsys-exports/bundle-20260212.jsonl.gz?X-Amz-SignedHeaders=..."
# fetch signature
curl -o bundle.jsonl.gz.sig "https://s3.amazonaws.com/finsys-exports/bundle-20260212.jsonl.gz.sig?X-Amz-SignedHeaders=..."
# verify (local)
openssl smime -verify -in bundle.jsonl.gz.sig -content bundle.jsonl.gz -inform DER -CAfile redwood-export-ca.pem
sha256sum bundle.jsonl.gz
```

olivia (solutions): Perfect. I'll assemble and send the SQ reply. Marking this thread actionable. Who's owning final QA?

emily (sec-eng): I'll QA the security wording and sign-off on the cryptographic bits.

raj (infosec): I'll double-check the separation-of-duties language and KMS key access model.

chris (sre): I'll attach the sample delivery manifests.

olivia (solutions): Great — thanks all. I'll update tracker and ping legal for the cert copy. :+1:

chris (sre): Closing note: for Private on-prem customers, remind them to enable HSM audit logging on their appliance; otherwise we only have the control-plane rotation metadata. We'll add that as a prerequisite in the response.
